xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnCommitteeTe: Mr. Ramesh Kumar Damani, Member of Risk Management Committee, is Group Chief Financial Officer of the Company. However, he is not a Member of the Board of Directors of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesToAnnexure1Ex: The report (i.e. report for the quater ended December 31, 2025) had been placed before the board of directors. No comments / observation / advice were received from the Board of Directors.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: In continuation of disclosure given by the Company in its Integrated Filing (Governance) for the quarter ended March 31, 2025 regarding levying of penalty of Rs. 3,92,802/- under Section 122(2)(b) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017 and Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017, and appeal filed against the order mentioned therein, the Company has received an order-in-appeal dated January 19, 2026 setting aside order-in-original dated February 3, 2025. Accordingly, penalty levied has been set aside entirely.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The appeal order sets aside the order-in-orginal dated February 3, 2025 alleging non-payment of tax by the Company under Reverse Charge Mechanism.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner State Taxes (Appeals I) Kashmir
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: In continuation of stock exchange intimation filed by TV18 Broadcast Limited (merged into the Company w.e.f. October 3, 2024) on April 4, 2024, an appeal was filed against the order, the Company has received an order-in-appeal dated February 27, 2026 upholding the penalty of Rs. 29,700/- imposed on the Company under Section 74 of the J&K GST Act, 2017.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The appeal order upholds the alleged non-payment of GST during the financial year 2018-19.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The financial impact is to the extent of the penalty levied. There is no impact on the operations or other activities of the Company due to the order.
